column2: The climate at the Gopalganj area is indications of typical climate patterns and expected

column1: conditions (temperature, precipitation, sunshine and wind) typically humid during extended summer
season, which covers from March to June. The annual average temperature of this district is 25.8oC and
annual average rainfall is 1809 mm. May is generally hottest and January is the coldest month. There have
been negative climactic impacts resulting water scarcity, rise in temperature and reduced rainfall. Rain
starts in April and the area receives maximum rain fall with in July. Rain and cold temperatures are not
very usual in Gopalganj inflicting hardship on the local community.
